Not measurements. Used only when no repatriated feature is bound.'","cuda_runtime.py is a CUDA host-runtime/memory-API subset (cudaMalloc, cudaMemcpy in both directions, <<<blocks, threads>>> launch, cudaDeviceSynchronize, cudaFree) parsed from CUDA host source and executed on Metal through AIR (receipt C2M-T1, goal G045) — a translation/execution shim on Apple Silicon, not an NVIDIA backend or driver binding.","cuda_runtime.py is fail-closed by construction: 'NOT A C PARSER', a line-oriented pattern matcher over named statement forms, refusing anything else with the statement quoted; the _UNSUPPORTED table names refused CUDA surface (cudaMallocManaged, cudaMemcpyAsync, streams, events, cudaMemset, cudaHostAlloc, cudaMallocPitch, cudaMemcpy2D, cudaGraphLaunch, cudaSetDevice, device-to-device) 'so a refusal says what the program used, not unsupported'.","cuda_runtime.py encodes a checkable safety condition: in UNIFIED mode cudaMalloc returns an alias and copies become no-ops, and HostProgram.may_delete_copies refuses that optimization when a host buffer copied to device is written again before the launch, because a host-to-device copy is a SNAPSHOT while an alias is a LIVE REFERENCE;
